## Type of Change

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and there are no TypeScript errors.
- [ ] I have run `bun run build` and the production build compiles cleanly.
- [ ] If changing database schema, I updated `src/server/db/schema.ts` and tested with `bun run db:push`.
- [ ] I have tested changes in both **Dark Mode** and **Light Mode**.
- [ ] Canvas elements and strokes are clearly visible with high contrast.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or local credentials are committed.
